aiQuote: 7.20.1 R (1) This rule applies where a borrower has failed to make a payment by the time it has fallen due under the terms of a regulated deferred payment credit agreement (‘a missed payment’).
reviewQuotation: (2) As soon as possible after a missed payment has occurred the firm must: (a) notify the borrower: (i) that the missed payment has occurred; and (ii) about any sums which have become payable under the regulated deferred payment credit agreement but remain unpaid
